title_en: Reliability set — everyone codes this one
title_vi: Bộ đo độ tin cậy — tất cả người gán nhãn đều làm bộ này

items.text: I had a neat, clean room that's just the right size for 1-2 people to hang out--right near International District.  The hosts provide clear help and instructions and are quick to respond to questions and calls for help.  Some neighborhood tips: For groceries, I suggest Uwajimaya, a short walk away.  For treats, try Beard Papa's, inside the Uwajimaya store.
Great stay. Well located, easy access in/out and nice to have laundry as I’m on a long trip and saves finding a laundry mat. Would highly recommend!

This is a great close-to-the-beach, relaxation spot. I loved hearing the ocean from the living room, and the beach was beautiful any time of day. The kitchen was well stocked with pots/pans/tools for making pretty much anything I could think of, and Annette was super communicative with information about my stay and things in the townhouse. It was a cute beach stay that was very relaxing.

Christine is a welcoming and gracious host. Her home was relaxing and a quick walk to the lake. It’s also only a short drive into Cong. I was disappointed I had to leave so soon and look forward to when I can visit again.
Absolutely fantastic location, close to Temple Bar and and all the shops etc.. Apartment was clean and comfortable, couldn’t fault it.  Will definitely be staying again.
Lucy’s place was modern, quiet, and easy to find. Close to all the major hot spots. We really enjoyed our stay!
Amazing house! Super spacious and everything was brand new ! Great location and great communication with the host!

Eugene and his family were very sweet and accommodating! My in laws stayed in his detached unit right in central downtown Mountain View and loved it! The place was clean, private and had all the necessities. Location was incredible and in general a very good stay, that we will definitely use again. Thank you!

My family's favorite air bnb in SD so far. Perfectly clean and full of amenities. The house just feels like a lux stay big enough for a family get-together. Great location. Lots of windows and views! Very sweet and helpful host.

The lovestream was a perfect getaway. The personalized gifts and handmade cinnamon rolls and cookies that were delivered each morning were such a sweet and unexpected touch. The hot tub was the perfect temp, the fireplace area was beautiful. Feeding the llamas carrots was so much fun and they were all so well behaved! We wanted to go for a hike so Joanna suggested Eagle Rock and was so great with directions and tips. The hike was beautiful. Both Michael and Joanna were very informative and friendly. You can tell they genuinely care about your stay.

Coyoacan is great neighborhood, but it's hard to find a place to stay there.  So Trisha's rooms are a great asset for travelers.  The room is comfortable and clean, and have an ideal location.  The Frida Kahlo house/museum is literally just around the corner, and the neighborhood's wonderful central plazas and gardens are just a few blocks away.  I had a wonderful time.

Giannis and his family were very sweet and helpful! His communication was great, and he was always ready to walk us through any questions or concerns that came up. The apartment was impeccably clean, modern, comfortable, and welcoming, and we were even surprised with homegrown tomatoes as a snack! Thanks again for the wonderful trip Giannis!

What a great find! We are so lucky to find this apartment and so glad it was available for our stay.  Cristina was a great host - very helpful and communicative in the lead up to our trip.  I would recommend this apartment highly - a great location for a visit to DC.
nice location but no windows to open . There is also cooking  equipment that is a bit oily. The noise from outside can be heard so bad.

great little apartment close to the metro for easy access. was too small for us as we had 5 adults in our group and there was 1 double bed, a fold out sofa and small single bed. would be perfect for families though.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for one night for a quick LA trip to get tattoos.  Azim has the most beautiful house and the loveliest dog. Azim was very nice from the very beginning, making sure we were situated before, during, and even after our stay at the house. Azim offered to make us breakfast, as well as gave us multiple options of places to go. We will 100% be staying here again next time we come to California. Thank you for the amazing stay!

Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay as it was very close to everything we wanted to do and we felt safe throughout the whole stay. Sokol was a very nice host and made sure we was fine the whole time..Thankyou again. Definitely would recommend if you are planning on staying in Athens 😊.

Antonia and her husband were absolutely wonderful! She checked in with me and gave me all the info i needed well before my stay. She checked in the day of also. I got some wrong transportation info from the airport and got a little turned around. She was super helpful and very responsive and got me where i needed to be. They even picked me up from the tram and helped with luggage. She had a home cooked meal waiting for me, which was a wonderful and delicious end to a stressful day 🥰. She gave me a thorough tour, including how to use the heated floors. She supplied wine, water, coffee, tea, chocolates, flatware, and toiletries. The bed was super comfortable, and i got a great night of sleep. I literally cannot say enough good things about them! The space was clean and comfortable and i felt right at home. Will definitely look her up again if im ever back in Germany ❤️

Un espacio excelente para 1-2 viajeros. Todo mega limpio, muy ordenado y además muy tranquilo y acogedor. Sin duda volvería a llegar aquí para pasar unos días. Excelente todo a mi punto de vista y Cristina súper anfitriona. Gracias por todo.
The AirBnb description is right on!  Beautiful, urban, upscale apartment.  4th floor (with an elevator).  Great beds and modern bathrooms.  Would rent this place again!
Mary’s  place was perfect!  Sparkling clean. Recent renovation. Great family oriented location. Close to restaurants and subway. This will definitely be our first choice for our next trip.  Thanks.

The place is great, awesome communication which is always a plus. Plenty of room and amenities. I read the reviews and knew there was a tenant upstairs, didn’t bother me but of you’re a light sleeper it might. Check out is at 10 which is earlier than I expected so I was 25 min late checking out, but it was clearly listed so my bad 100%. Pool table, guitar on the wall, some work out equipment and an awesome bathroom…this place was perfect for us. The hosts are super polite and responsive

I went for a solo trip to Lisbon, I had an incredible time. The location was fab, I was able to walk everywhere. Lots of great places to eat very close by. Would highly recommended staying here, super comfy bed and the entire place was so clean and tidy. I didn’t want to leave!  The lockers were such a great touch too, very handy when you have a couple of hours spare before leaving.
Great apartment in the best location in Rome. Host is responsive and accommodating. Apartment is modern, clean and well equipped.

The cottage on Sunset beach was more than we imagined it.  The view was amazing, and for a couple who  isn't into nightlife, the location was unbeatable.  Well decorated, clean, comfortable, complete with dolphins off the beach.

Quirky and may not be to everyones taste but a fantastic location in the old town centre and everything associated with that. Nestled in the roof tops with 2 terraces. The top one nicely planted with views to the edge of the city and at night, with the cathedrals and church spires all lit up. Early evening the sku was alive with swallows and swifts diving and weaving through the roof scape like supernaturally agile fighter planes. Great accompaniment to a Spanish measure of G&T and some jamon. Three flights of stairs to the front door and one more to the kitchen and a further one to the top roof terrace - might need to get some training in before you go. We chose to bring a car to get out of the city to climb but it's expensive if you want to be close by 27Eu a day. Might be able to find cheaper further out. If you just stay in the city, don't need a car and it's pretty easy to get around.

A estadia no apartamento foi muito boa, a comunicação com o Nicolas foi excelente, esteve sempre disposto a nos ajudar. Já o apartamento possui uma excelente localização, é próximo do metrô, costanera e Cerro San Cristóbal, da pra fazer muita coisa em Santiago de apé mesmo! Super recomendo!

This was the MOST adorable spot for our Best Friends Day 2021 trip! It looks just like the pictures! It was very clean, smelled nice and had great amenities including a great upper deck and washer/dryer! The complimentary champagne was also fabulous and needed after a day of travel.  Parking was very easy. We never had a problem with someone parking in her designated spots.  ❤️  The location is prime as there are two great bars right next to it. Kingas Lounge downstairs (she owns the building/Airbnb) and Tooeys right next door. We would start our night with a cocktail at Kingas and always come back to finish the night.  Because it’s downtown, there are definitely a lot of homeless junkies around and one we encountered was particularly violent. We never felt *unsafe* - you have to input 3 codes just to get in your place - but just be cautious when you’re out of the gate. Also, they do congregate on the streets below yelling and tweaking out so keep that in mind if you are a light sleeper.   We got to meet Kinga coincidentally and she was so sweet and accommodating! Definitely recommend staying here!

Für uns der perfekte Ort für einen Aufenthalt in Rom: Hervorragende Lage in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße trotz morgendlich kommunikativer Nachbarschaft gegenüber, verschiedene Buslinien und die U-Bahn im Umkreis von 5 bis maximal 10 Minuten mit Anbindung an viele Sehenswürdigkeiten, sehr urbanes und typisch römisches Stadtviertel ohne Touristenmassen, gute Einkaufs- und unterschiedlichen Essensmöglichkeiten (z.B. ein speziell glutenfreies Restaurant 2 Minuten entfernt).   Bei Fabrizio ist man bestens aufgehoben, ein wahrer Superhost , sehr gastfreundlich, kommunikativ, sehr hilfsbereit, jederzeit ansprechbar mit sehr guten Empfehlungen und Ratschlägen. Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet, sauber, in der Küche kann man gut Frühstück oder kleinere Gerichte zubereiten, auch wenn wir scharfe Messer vermisst haben. Alle wichtigen Verbrauchsgüter wie Seife, Spülmittel usw. sind vorhanden.  Alles in allem auch ein sehr gutes Preis- Leistungsverhältnis - vielen Dank Fabrizio, bis zum nächsten Mal.
Nice cozy space. Neat. Clean. Fully stocked. Private parking. We really couldn’t have asked for more. Teresa I’d great!

This was an awesome, incredible, amzing and overall perfect vacation for us. You can either do a lot of exploring or can just have a relaxed day at the house. Irene and Dave are the perfect hosts: having always a story to tell or a tipp for sightseeing or even just for finding a good restaurant. Irene had always an off-the-map tipp to visit or to eat at. They are always asking if you need anything and will bend backwards to accomodate you if necessary. The house and grounds are beautiful and you can spend days just exploring and always finding a new place. The first walk around the estate was breathtaking and Dave visions about the future and the ecological impact of his plans are already showing.  The additional four-legged hosts are just as perfect as the human ones. You can take a walk with Bruce or throw a stick (or several) for Benny. Even the cats are either ready to play or just to snuggle with. We stayed nine days and did a lot of exploring different places in Ireland. The house is located in the middle of Ireland, so that you are able to see a lot of different places. We hope to visit the Maxwell family again!

It was such a lovely apartment, clean and tidy, also decorated with fine ikea furniture. Internet is working perfectly, hot water is always available. Quiet during the day and night. It is good for short or long term stay. Walking distance to most of the city attractions. 5 mins walk to supermarkets, trains and bus stops. You just cross the main road and there are many cafes, restaurants and bars such as szimpla kert. Christina was such a friendly host, always helpfull and easy to reach.  We highly recommend this place.

Anna was an amazing host, was very nice and responsive despite the fact our flight was delayed and we arrived at 2am. she was extremely helpful with local recommendations and when asked also helped us plan our trip to the north of Scotland. in addition she did our laundry (for free!) and we had a lovely breakfast together. all in all one of the best airB&B Experiences we ever had!

Nida was very friendly and her place had everything you would need. Her place is in the most perfect location. Walking distance to everything including less than a minute to the train. It was also a bonus that Nidas place is located in Hongkongs art lane with beautiful art murals down the alley way used to access Nidas place.

What a wonder time we had at the cabin. Our host was great at communicating, and even welcomed us at the door singing with her mandolin! lol Tucked away in the mountains well above Malibu, we got the best of both worlds. Great times at the beach and a wonderful mountain retreat. Thank you so much, we will be telling family and friends about your place for years to come

Quentin was very helpful before, during, and after our stay. I was provided with clear instructions about accessing the apartment and what would be available well before my arrival.  The apartment is quite close to the metro at the Arc de Triomphe (Étoile) and is really within 5 minutes by foot. The neighborhood is rather high-end (I was there on a Saturday and the bars were closing at 19:00; I suppose to keep the scoundrels at bay or something) but it is not hard at all to find a place for a drink, dinner, or shopping. The Champs-Elysées are just  stone's throw away, of course.  The apartment itself is well-appointed and clean. The view is simply beautiful. It is on the top floor (the sixth) and it is reached by a spiral staircase, no elevator. I do not advise this accommodation for those with bad knees, heart or lung issues, or lots of baggage. I was rewarded for my efforts with a silly good view of southern Paris ranging from the Louvre to the Eiffel Tower. My friend and I stayed in for a while just so we could share a beer and watch the sun set.  I think this was a great find, mainly for the view and the communication with the host. The apartment itself is clean and well-

This place is fantastic and got everything you need. Located in popular area, Ari which you can enjoy many of restaurants,  cafe, massage shops. yummy street food and market. Only 5 minutes walk to  BTS train (Ari station) so you can go to explore Bangkok easily.  The host is super friendly and helpful. Definitely come back and stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay in Manuel's appartement, which is completely renovated. Every bedroom and the living room has air condition, which was very important during our stay (it was very hot these days). The kitchen has all the things you need (inclusive a dishwasher, washing machine, microwave...). You can reach the old town by walking (about 20 min to Plaza de Jerez) or by bus or metro. We had a great time in Seville. Thank you Manuel and Gabriel!

Romina es lo mejor!!! Su hogar te va a encantar, desde el primer contacto ya te sientes en tu casa!  Es muy cómodo y tienes todo lo que necesitas para vivir. A 5 cuadras de San Fe, cercano a farmacias, clínicas, comida por peso, supermercados, a 2 cuadras del Subte, y muchos más!

What an absolute beautiful flat with a view of the most beautiful tree from the terrace. I will never be able to get that view out of my head. Laura met us right outside the lift and showed us everything we needed to know about the apartment. The apartment had everything we needed for our comfort, to include wifi, espresso and American coffee, air conditioning among many other features. She even left a bottle of Chianti for us to enjoy our first night!  This apartment is within 15 minutes walking distance to everything you will need or want to do while you stay in the beautiful city of Firenze. "Take your breath away" took a whole new meaning for my wife and I. Thank you so much, Laura, for allowing us to stay in your beautiful home.
A great location with the subway, shops and restaurants nearby.  The host was very responsive to any questions.  The unit was very clean and comfortable.
We loved our stay, it felt homely and was in a great location to get into the busy city every day. It was warm and cosy and perfect for us. Thank you!

We really enjoyed our stay in Natcha's apartment. It was beautifully furnished, clean and made great use of the space. The space was enough for 4 friends as there was a very comfortable sofa bed as well as a double bed and it made a great bolthole from which to explore Paris. The flat is in a central location and really good for getting around Paris as it is in walking distance of most places and also well connected with a number of Metro stations nearby. It was only a 10-15 minute walk from Gare du Nord which makes it handy if catching the Eurostar! Natcha was very helpful and quick to respond to any questions particularly as we only booked 24 hours in advance. Check-in was easy and although we didn't get to meet Natcha she arranged for someone to meet us and show us around the flat when we arrived. A great place to stay!

Very nice place, 5 minutes from the train station, 30 minutes walking from the center. A nice park crossing the street. The place is great for 4 people. It has 2 comfy beds, a nice living room and kitchen. The street is somewhat noisy, and as it was very hot the days we stayed, you had to keep the windows open, but otherwise it was great. The design is clean and modern, really liked it. The kitchen has all you need to cook if that's what you like, either for breakfast/lunch/dinner. A coffee machine, teapot, toaster, oven, and so on. Enough plates and cutlery for 6 or more people. The only thing that was a surprise was some bad smell from the washing room and/or bathroom. We told Simon and he offered some tips (using the washing machine, for instance) and althugh it did help, it did not remove the smell completely. But having those doors closed and the windows from the appartment opened at least a bit did help. It probably was just bad luck on our stay. Would go back definitely!
Perfect studio with great decor ! The building is well located. Ana Paula was very accommodating and responsive.

This home is in a beautiful location of Dursoduro. Far enough away from the tourist crowds but close enough to venture out see all the important landmarks and hidden gems that Venice has to offer. Though it is not in the super touristy part of Venice it is walking distance to Venice St. Lucia train station (15min)  and 3 min walk to restaurants that sit on within a small square.  You can easily walk around Venice or take the public water boat called a vaporetto to get to any part of the island you want to. Everywhere we turned there was beautiful architecture, stores, things to do.  The home its self is clean, comfortable, well equipped kitchen, and it was lovely to be able to do a load of laundry.  Elena was an extremely kind and responsive host. She was readily available to answer any questions I had even prior to booking. She offered to hold our luggage after checkout and even left us some beautiful cards with her husband’s artwork on it which we will cherish. We would book again!

L'appartement est tres agreable et bien équipé. Prez avait tout prevu pour notre bébé.  Il est situé dans une zone ou il y a des restaurants et des commerces accessibles a pieds, ou en taxi. Prez a ete tres attentif, en arrivant il nous a fourni une carte de la ville avec des indications, nous sommes arrivés un dimanche soir il nous a indiqué un restaurant ouvert a proximité. Pendant notre sejour il nous a fourni des informations et des conseils sur les choses a faire. Merci encore ne changez rien vous etes super ! 😊

Pobyt v tomto apartmánu přečkal naše očekávání. Lokalita byla dopravně velmi dobře dostupná a nacházela ze velmi blízko hlavních pražských památek a atrakcí. Apartmán byl velmi prostorný, luxusně zařízený a velmi čistý. Komunikace s majitelem probíhala velmi rychle a efektivně. Určitě můžu toto ubytování jen doporučit a pokud budu mít možnost, určitě ho znovu využiji, naskytne-li se mi příležitost navštívit Prahu.

The place was really nice and the owners were are very friendly. We were welcomed and farewelled with a nice gift and if we had any questions our hosts were very helpful. The apartment was well equipped which made even more advanced cooking possible. Poppy's place will for sure remain on our list of locations to revisit and again enjoy its magical atmosphere.

We had a wonderful family vacation in this home! The house is beautiful and a Karen was wonderful. A nice walk either way to amenities... and a little longer walk takes you straight to city center. We loved it!!
Nice and clean accommodations close to downtown, would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Nashville.

We spent two beautiful nights in Claudio’s apartment. Very cozy, practical, clean and with lots of light. The highlight for us was first the welcoming from Denis who was friendly, helpful with sightseeing recommendations and available for any extra request. Secondly, the perfect location of the apartment in an inside courtyard which allowed us to have a quiet and restful sleep. We also loved the neighborhood with small restaurants, cafés, arts and crafts stores, a bit different from the typical tourists traps and with a more local personality which put us in contact with a realistic vision of the Florentine life. The day of our departure we were happy to meet Claudio’s Mom, a very gentle and friendly person who made us feel at home. We recommend this B&B and will visit it again next time we are in Florence. Arrivederci.   Gabriela & Mucho

Isaac and his place were amazing!! I especially liked the early check-in, the staff, the parking, the space and the clinliness of the room, and the location. Isaac introduced himself to me very professionally and made me feel very  welcomed and safe as to where I was going to be staying. I can honestly say that I am definitely impressed with this location keeping it's guest expectations and hospitality standards a top priority, considering that the other surrounding area options lacks in doing this. Isaac and his staff made me their top priority. I enjoyed my trip so much that I actually even extended my trip one more day... with no issues at all. From now on I will always make Isaac's place my #1 choice for where I'll be staying for now and forever.. Thank you Isaac!!

Mary is a lovely, welcoming fun host. Her home is perfectly clean and comfortable. Cake and scones on arrival were a tasty bonus, she cooked us  great breakfast and we had a stunning view over Slievenamon, all made for a very enjoyable stay. Ideal for local places of interest like Fethard. Highly recommended 😊

Mark and Doug are wonderful people who you will love to have as your hosts. The place is beautiful, comfortable, very clean, central and easily accessible from the airport. They have lots of good recommendations for doing things around the city.  They are well traveled and super nice to talk to. I was alone for a conference and it made all the difference to stay with this amazing couple. Thank you, guys!

I had a fantastic experience at Maria's place. I was I was there for longer than 2 nights!  Her location is fantastic. You can see the Parthenon and museum from the windows or balcony. The walk to either of these is incredibly short. Its also less than a 5 minute walk from the Acropoli Metro Station. If you're looking for a place that is easy to find from the airport, this is it.   The place was very clean, very nice, and was exactly what I expected. I will hopefully have the chance to return and stay here again! :)

Unfortunately I was unable to attend the trip but my colleague who went absolutely loved Justin's place. It was exactly as shown in the pictures, and a quick walk to tons of attractions and good places to eat. Justin allowed us to check-in early, and even offered to let us come a whole day early at no extra cost. Would definitely stay here again!
Tim was fantastic with us. He was very quick to respond to any questions asked. The flat is in an excellent location and it was what we expected and more
Best location in North Park. Great communication and the place is as described. Definitely recommend!

The cottage has everything you need for a quiet and private getaway. A good flat walk into town for eateries and boutiques and the beach. The cottage itself has two bedrooms and the main is quite large with a two way bathroom attached. Washer and drier. Ceiling fans in all rooms. Plus aircon in living area. Super clean and comfy. Lovely linen, towels, shampoo, conditioner, body wash provided,  and some other extras.  We would definitely stay in the cottage again

All we can say is that we made a great decision by choosing to stay at Catherine’s apartment. It is a 3-minute walk to the metro station and we enjoyed walking around the area of Le Marais. As far as the apartment is concerned, it is just beautiful and cosy. Catherine offers her guests the use of a coffee machine well stocked with coffee. The kitchen is a great place to cook and the living room has comfortable sofas. We slept well because it is very quiet. Whenever our travels take us back to Paris, we will gladly stay at Catherine’s apartment.  We did not have the pleasure of meeting Catherine but she was always available to answer our questions on What’s App.

We really enjoyed staying at this property.  We searched all over Las Vegas for the right fit for my wife and 3 adult daughters.  This was perfect.  Very spacious and great floor plan.  Beds were comfortable and the rooms were very clean and plenty of room .  The kitchen and dining room were very large and had plenty of supplies to cook meals.  The backyard was wonderful and very spacious also.  Awesome pool and plenty of space to hang out around the pool.  We chose March so the pool of course was cool, but we knew that going in.  Instructions were excellent to point out that if you wanted the pool to be heated you could make that choice.  The host was very accommodating and kept in touch with us during our stay to make sure that things were there, if we needed them.  The neighborhood is very nice  and easy to access the area for travel.  I would definitely recommend staying here while in Vegas.  You won't be disappointed.

Very nice big flat, near to train  (15 Min. per feet) and the historic center but quite at night. Essentials like tea, coffee, sugar, salt, oil etc. and shampoo/shower gel  where there. The terrace is big and sunny, no elavator but it's not very exhausting to climb the stairs. It was very clean and a lot of pads and blankets where there. Thank you! We will come again!

We had an excellent stay at this apartment. Even though Esther couldn't meet us in person, we felt welcome from the first moment her friend Jackie let us in to the apartment. Esther was still a great host, checking in regularly to make sure we were comfortable and happy. The apartment is beautiful - exactly as pictured, clean and comfortable and with all the amenities you might need for a stay. The location is perfect for exploring the center of Lisbon, within walking distance to everything, including the train station, Metro and bus lines. Lovely airbnb experience.

Sylviane was very easy to talk to and her responses were quick. She is very accommodating and allowed me to check-in and check-out at a time favourable to me. There is a great view and sunset from the balcony. The place was clean and not warm at all in late August. Going up the apartment with luggages was easy due to the presence of an up-riding escalator and lift. There is one flight of stairs you will have to descend. But by all Parisian accounts it is very convenient for travellers with luggages.  As for the location, I did not feel unsafe on my walk back at night. It is not the typical chic Parisian streets and houses you would perhaps imagine. However it still has it's own charm and is simply a different side to Paris. The food & supermarket you can find nearby are affordable. There are a number of asian restaurants around. Being in the 18th arrondissement, it is not quite as close to the tourist sites of Sacré Coeur but it was still a distance I found pretty walk-able and where I discovered some interesting street art while seeing Paris.  This place would also be great to stay at if you're looking to practice your French! Sylviane speaks good english but is helpful with Frenc

Ho's place is very well located just a block away from a subway station on line 1 and only a few blocks away from Central park. There is also a nice park around the corner that my son enjoyed. It was very hot during our stay but the AC in the living room and bedrooms was perfectly fine. The description is quite accurate, nothing was missing, and the pictures don't do it justice, it is quite roomy. Thanks!
We had a lovely stay! David and Sara were very nice, the room was very clean and cozy, and the location of the house is amazing. Thank you!
Martina was very communicative and super friendly. The apartment is beautiful and clean! Great location, especially for a first time visitor. Would definitely stay again!

What a wonderful little spot to stay in the northern parts of Bogotá. Is close enough to big malls (UNICENTRO, SENTRY) but far enough to not noticed them. The apt is also only 3 blocks away from transmilenio (the most efficient way to travel the city) which is an advantage itself. CEDRITOS and COLINA CAMPESTRE (Two of the most beautiful neighbours in BOG) are in walking distance, so during this crisis where enough street parks to walk/jog to. Police is 3 blocks away and ATM services are 800 meters far (BANCOLOMBIA). This sounds great. . . until you met the butcher, probably one of the most colourful characters I have ever met. Oscar, is just the embodiment of all the good traits of hard-working Colombians. He is a very strong opinionated individual but with a big heart and a natural laid back attitude. If your Spanish is well enough, just go talk to the guy he is really HILARIOUS ! while he sells you poultry and will make you feel like home. The apts are really cleverly designed, so 1 maybe 2 people will be more than comfortable there. Drawers are spacious and clean, bed linen was spotless and the apartments feel fresh and clean. There is also a third-floor balcony which allow for
It was a perfect little room to stay in while in Nashville. It was very clean and looked just like the photos. Everything was close by to our AirBNB and we couldn't have been happier.

Fantastic unit, so close to everything. Incredibly clean, particularly for a rental that allows pets, you would never know an animal had ever stayed before. It’s so nice to be able to stay in comfort and luxury with your pet in tow. Sarah was extremely helpful and all communication was prompt. Will be recommending to all my friends for stays on the Sunshine Coast.
This is just a great little place. Very clean. It’s not on the Strip, so you get to experience the real Las Vegas, but close enough that it’s a quick drive or Uber away.

Lien's place is super nice. The location is near the station, 20min walk to the city center and exactly as on the pictures. The apartment has everything you need for a stay in Naples. We really loved Lien's kindness and help! She even brought us breakfast, what we really appreciated and didn't expected. I would highly recommend this place and will for sure come back one day!

Traveled with two families of four and found the house to be exceptionally spacious. The kids loved the bunk room and the adults had huge bedrooms and bathrooms. One master and the bunk room are located on one side of the house, while the other is in the living area wing (each side is separated by a huge screened in patio). This particular house is directly across from the leisure centre, which we loved. Only thing we didn’t pack, but needed, was paper towels (which they didn’t sell at the little general store). Beach is a two minute drive, the pub is a ten minute walk, and the house had everything we could have asked for. Such a relaxing escape and an awesome alternative to Noosa. Will be back for sure.

La casa de Anna es un lugar para ir a desconectar ya que se encuentra rodeado de pinos y con vistas al mar. La casa se encuentra delante de la piscina comunitaria y es muy agradable bajar a hacer un chapuzón mientras preparas la comida. La casa es grande y espaciosa. Tanto ella como la persona que nos vino a recibir han sido muy agradables!!!

If you want to feel that you are in the real Berlin, then Sanne Maria and Natalie’s apartment is the best place to stay. The apartment, located close to Boxhagener Platz is very spacious, combining the vintage with the modern. It was extremely clean, and well-appointed. Natalie communicated with us before we arrived and was available to answer any questions. The U Bahn station is only a few minutes-walk away, and takes you directly to the center of Berlin. There are lots of places to eat close by, and a vibrant street market on Saturdays in Boxhagener Platz.

We enjoyed our stay at Jo and Hans' appartement. Especially because it is really near to the center, you can reach everything you need or want to see in just a few minutes. Besides that, we enjoyed a couple of local bars and cafés where there were no tourists at all. The appartement is clean and tydi. Hans introduced us kindly to the appartement and the surrounding area, as there's a nice park right in front of the window. We can highly recomend this place.  Thank you Jo and Hans for having us!

My friends and I had a great time in Montreal and our accommodations at Julie's were great. The house was professionally cleaned before we arrived, was warm, and had everything we needed. It's in a good location and Julie was available if we needed anything. I would stay again!

Gostaria de expressar minha gratidão pela excelente estadia no seu imóvel. Desde o momento em que cheguei, fui recebido com um ambiente limpo, organizado e extremamente aconchegante. A decoração cuidadosamente pensada e a atenção aos detalhes fizeram toda a diferença, proporcionando uma sensação de conforto e bem-estar. A localização também é perfeita, com fácil acesso a todas as comodidades necessárias e pontos turísticos da região, oferecendo momentos de tranquilidade. A hospitalidade do anfitrião foi impecável, sempre disponível para qualquer dúvida ou necessidade que surgisse durante minha estadia. Recomendo vivamente este lugar para quem procura uma experiência agradável. Com certeza voltarei na próxima oportunidade.

Jan is a very hospitable and considerate landlord, he gave us great privacy. Rooms are very clean, and the overall environment is very comfortable. The location is unbeatable with amazing scenery. Price is really reasonable consider the amazing view we had. Also, this location has easy access to public transportation. The kitchen is well-equipped with suppliance, and we were able to make our own breakfast and every meal, makes us feel like home.  We will definitely come back if we ever visit Vancouver again .

Very nice place, perfect for group of three. Beach located just a few minutes walking. Easy to get to major historical attractions and city of Heraklion. We enjoyed our stay here a lot. Good WiFi connection - always a bonus:)

Fabulous apartment, had everything we needed and in a great location. Great communication with host. Lots of info before trip and apartment has all the information about Budapest. Air con was great 😃 when we return it'll be the first place we'll look to book🥰
Just had a great weekend at the bird house, if you’re looking for a stone built studio cottage with slate floors, exposed wooden beams, tranquil views and all the comforts of home, look no further.

Kru Ae is definitely a hospitality host. We arrived very late @3am, he waited until our arrival and helped to call the Grap Taxi when our leave. The location is very near to the airport, about 10minutes by taxi, and around there are local food easy can find, we tried the noodle and coconut juice Kru Ae recommended as our brunch, taste very fresh! Also recommend you go further, it is a small food shop, their special is mango with sticky rice, manga is very very fresh! You can tell from their decoration, they put a lot mango in the store, the lady is very nice. Kru Ae's house is easy can regoniz from the pink wall when you are in the ally in case you lost. The room is very clean and quiet, you can enjoy a comfortable sleep!

Ana's Airbnb was perfect for our 4 day stay in San Francisco. The location is only about 7 blocks from the ocean. It was a very easy walk and Ana provided beach chairs and blanket. There were many fun restaurants and coffee shops in the neighborhood within walking distance. The place was very clean and spacious for two people. Ana provided wonderful coffee and La Croix. We will definitely be staying at Ana's place again

This place was great!!! Just a few minute walk from the port, the location is amazing and just as described. Marousi was a wonderful host and extremely communicative. The patio was everything, we had breakfast out there every morning. I stayed with my daughter and had plenty of space. I would definitely recommend this place and would stay again myself.

Lokatie is super. In een rustige straat, maar om de hoek een leuk plein met horeca en in een zijstraat winkels.  We troffen het appartement niet bezemschoon aan en er was een onaangename geur waarneembaar. Gelukkig was het contact hierover goed en is dit waar mogelijk opgelost.  Het appartement is heel ruim. Bedden zijn prima.  De prijs kwaliteit verhouding is  heel gunstig. Aanrader !

O apartamento Studio é lindo, muito bem montado  e a vista incrível , Daria e sua família foram muito atenciosos desde o momento que fechamos a estadia , no momento que chegamos ao apt e em nossa saída .. a localização e estrutura do prédio nos atendeu perfeitamente .. Vamos voltar com certeza .. !!

We had the most wonderful honeymoon here!! Not only was the place nice and clean, but it was peaceful and relaxing too. Roger also had beach chairs and towels, etc for us to use for the beach. Roger was very kind and friendly to work with. He gave us many awesome recommendations, was proactive, and very responsive.  We absolutely loved our trip, it was the perfect honeymoon and we would love to go back!

Absolutely wonderful stay! Jeff was incredibly communicative and went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. The place itself was spotless and came equipped with all the amenities one could hope for. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free experience.

This place was excellent! It was new, modern, beautiful, and had everything needed to make yourself comfortable. It had indoor parking that was opened and closed by the security guard. Being new, the place was super clean. The building was quiet. The bed and the pillows were super comfortable. The area is in the north side of Bogotá, which is pretty safe, and there were plenty of restaurants and supermarkets around. Juan Pablo was responsive and kept in touch.  The check-in and check-out processes were super easy with the help of the security guard. The wifi was fast and good for video streaming or working. I would definitely recommend it to anyone!

Abbiamo scelto l'alloggio in base alla posizione utile ai nostri spostamenti ed abbiamo trovato una struttura perfetta per 4 persone: molto elegante, pulita, ordinata e completa, con tutti i comfort presenti in descrizione. Veramente disponibili per checkin e checkout in orari scomodi, molto reattiva anche nel rispondere alle nostre richieste.  Consigliatissimo :)))

Zoe's place is phenomenal. The view out the corner window and from her patio was gorgeous. There were many thoughtful touches provided by the host. Perfect location...in the heart of Victoria and close to everything.  The restaurant, Agrius, downstairs was amazing. If you stay here, treat yourself  for breakfast, you won't be sorry. Any questions I had for Zoe was answered promptly. The condo was very clean and modern. Loved the record player and record selection. Would definitely stay here again and will recommend it to others.
Wonderful clean place! Minimalist at its best and the perfect place to wind down the night after a night out on the town!

Incredible views of Oslo! Very comfortable, beautifully decorated flat. Close to transportation and within walking distance to many restaurants and shops. This was a great home base for enjoying Oslo like a local.

Leanne was an amazing host, very friendly and helpful. Her dog, Zara, was very well-behaved and a true pleasure to have in our company. We spent a lot of our time out on the patio just enjoying the sound of birds singing. It was very peaceful despite being fairly close to the city.

Nino's apartment is in an excellent location, walking distance to basically everywhere in the Old Town and also very close to bus stops that go to Mondello. The Stazione Centrale is also at walking distance from the apartment. All the rooms are of perfect size, communal area is spacious and there is a very comfortable hammock in the living room as well! The photos on airbnb don't do the apartment justice! There is also a very nice terrace which can fit perfectly around 12 people at a time. The host was very helpful and very very nice to us for our whole stay, she always answered all of our questions regarding directions and places to go in Palermo.  We all loved staying at this apartment, would totally recommend it to everyone! Grazie di tutto!

Pobyt v tomto apartmáne bol skvelý. Izby boli čisté. Kuchyňa je kompletne vybavená, čiže bez problémov si tam pripravíte všetko od raňajok, až po večeru. Poloha je tiež dobrá, do 10 minút sa dostanete k vlaku, ako aj k MHD. Birgitt sa celý pobyt uisťovala, či je všetko v poriadku,  čo značí, že jej záleží na tom, aby ste sa u nej cítili ako doma a nič vám nechýbalo. Ak opäť navštívime Viedeň, tak sa sem určite vrátime.

Great place to stay, apartments are spot on, very cool and spacious. Location couldn’t be better, you have everything on your doorstep. Staff are brilliant and very helpful! Definitely coming up again soon.

Angielena was very helpful and informative. Fantastic location with easy access to downtown and Seatac airport via public transportation (about 30 min rides). The room was very nice and the bed was comfortable. The building has many rooms that are rented to travelers so it still felt like you were staying at a hotel but at an affordable price in a great location! You have a private room and there are a few bathrooms that you share with the other guests. I never had an issue with being able to use one and they were very clean. At least one of them (only one I used for showering) has a very lovely shower!  There is also a well-stocked kitchen. I know some reviews mentioned the noise from the bar but the earplugs block it out pretty well and it didn't interfere with my sleep (and I'm a light sleeper). The building also has a lot of charm as does the neighborhood it is located in. There are a few restaurants on the block. Overall a great stay!
